notesForTechWriter: New public method `getLogsByType(type: string)` added to `ConsoleLogger` (packages/saturday-core/src/utils/console-logger.ts) — returns captured console log entries whose `type` matches the argument, in original capture order; returns `[]` (never undefined) for unmatched, empty-string, or unrecognized type values.
No public API signature changed for existing methods (`getLogs`, `getFormattedLogs`, `clear`) — this is a pure addition, safe for a changelog 'Added' entry rather than 'Changed'.
